author: Asraf Jaafar Sidik

This guide is independent training material and is not published or endorsed by Microsoft. All companies, people and documents in the course scenario are fictional.
backCover: This book accompanies the one-day Copilot Chat Basic Workshop. It follows one purchase at a fictional Malaysian company, from checking which Copilot you have, through writing requirements with the GCSE framework, comparing three supplier quotations against a procurement policy and chasing the vendors in Outlook, to a justification memo on a Copilot Page, a Notebook for the whole purchase and a Quotation Checker agent you build yourself. Every chapter gives point-and-click steps and ready-to-paste prompts that work with Copilot Chat (Basic), without the paid Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
